halves.name: Open-Book Golden Retriever
halves.desc: You love out loud: warm, gentle, all in, and mostly by your own rulebook.

axes.line: Your people are your happy place. Close means shared.
You hold the person first. The hard part can wait for a gentler moment.
You write your own script for love, home and holidays.

halves.name: Slow-and-Steady Regular
halves.desc: Your days run on routine and order, and you're in no rush to prove anything to anyone.

axes.line: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.
A fair process keeps everyone safe. A rule is a rule.

stings: You'll break any rule for your people, except the one where you tell them what hurt.
Your life is so steady that some nights you wonder if it's too steady.
hearts: I'd rather love too much than too carefully.
I chose my ordinary days. I didn't settle for them.

tags.name: Limited-edition energy
tags.heart: I charge myself first, so I have more to give.
tags.sting: Your kindness has a daily cap. When it's gone, it's gone.

youToldGenii.said: Paid my share. Home by 9. Completely peopled out.
'Got a thing tonight.' The thing: my couch.
Pretend I'm asleep. Text them first thing at 7am.

tags.name: Minimalist on purpose
tags.heart: Less stuff, more room to breathe.
tags.sting: You saved the money and the time. What exactly are you saving them for?

youToldGenii.said: Cleared out a few old ones first, then bought it.
The other pair. The 11 videos were the fun part.
Ready in six minutes. Hoodie, keys, done.

tags.name: Actually read the rulebook
tags.heart: Fair isn't cold to me. It's safe.
tags.sting: You trust the process, because you don't trust people to wing it.

youToldGenii.said: Asked whoever's in charge, then went with their answer.
Pull up the official rules. Read them out loud.
First to ask gets it. That was the deal.

tags.name: Here, scroll my phone
tags.heart: Letting you all the way in is how I feel safe.
tags.sting: You say you have nothing to hide. You're quietly hoping they have nothing to hide either.

youToldGenii.said: Handed my best friend my phone: "Write the follow-up. Make it chill."
Type mine into their phone before they finish the sentence.
Always. Come find me. I'm the dot at 4%.

tags.name: Still loading, and that's fine
tags.heart: My timeline is mine to write.
tags.sting: You're not against settling down. You just hate being rushed.

youToldGenii.said: Double-tapped. Forgot it by the next video.
Don't you dare. Finding out is the fun part.
Changed plans four times. Happier every time.

calls.line: You've let a call ring out, then texted 'what's up?' ten seconds later.
You've unsubscribed from every store newsletter.
You've actually read the terms and conditions on something.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘Eat. Save them a plate and send a photo.’ Last time, you did: ‘Asked whoever's in charge, then went with their answer.’
